passages.text: Noccaea perfoliata is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is an annual native to southern, central, and southeastern Europe, North Africa, and western and central Asia from the eastern Mediterranean to the Altai, Xinjiang, and Pakistan.
